name: Memory (Recall)
description: Long-term memory kept in Recall by Polign. A new statement replaces the old one and the old one stays in the history, so the agent sees corrections and can read memory as of any earlier time.

cliCommands.name: recall
cliCommands.description: Search, remember, forget, and check the Recall memory server

url.label: Recall server URL
url.help: Where `recall serve` listens. Defaults to $RECALL_URL, then http://127.0.0.1:8080.

apiKey.label: Recall key
apiKey.help: A key minted with `recall key create`. Defaults to $RECALL_API_KEY. The key chooses the namespace the memories live in.

autoRecall.label: Auto-recall
autoRecall.help: Before each turn, ask Recall what bears on the message and put it in front of the prompt.

autoCapture.label: Auto-capture
autoCapture.help: After each turn, send the recent conversation to Recall so it can work out what to keep.

maxMemories.label: Memories per turn
maxMemories.help: How many remembered statements auto-recall puts in front of the prompt.

captureMessages.label: Messages to capture
captureMessages.help: How many of the latest messages auto-capture sends after a turn.

timeoutMs.label: Tool timeout (ms)
timeoutMs.help: How long the agent's memory tools wait for Recall. Storing waits for the extraction model.

captureTimeoutMs.label: Capture timeout (ms)
captureTimeoutMs.help: How long one auto-capture waits for Recall. Captures run in the background after the turn.
